text:
Alex: Heads up — noticed tenant T-931 exceeded its reserved throughput briefly but was still served from other nodes for ~18s. Seen in prod dedicated cluster us-west-2.
Priya: do you mean we let them burst into other tenants' capacity? that's bad — logs?
Alex: pasted snippet:
```
2026-03-17T18:23:10Z tenant=T-931 node=n7 request_id=abc123 reserved_util=100% in_flight=12 allow_from_shared=true
2026-03-17T18:23:12Z tenant=T-931 routed_to=node=n3 serve_ok
```
Priya: allow_from_shared flag sounds familiar — it's an older soft-fallback we rolled out for shortfalls.
Marc: that fallback was supposed to only kick when local node underutilized and global reserved is saturated. looks like mismatch in our leader election for quota windows.
Diane: we need to be explicit: per-org reserved throughput must be isolated; short bursts should be satisfied from tenant's own burst credit only.
Jess: telemetry question — how would console show this? currently we only surface 429s per-tenant, not cross-node borrow events.
Alex: proposal: add metric reserved_crossnode_borrow{tenant} and an alert when >0.1% of tokens served from non-dedicated-pool.
Priya: also backend change: evaluate enforcement at router-level before routing decision. if tenant out of burst and global reserved is saturated, router should 429 or queue, not route to other tenant nodes.
Marc: concern: queueing will increase p95; we can do short 100ms queue then 429 with Retry-After.
Diane: make it opt-in rollout: feature flag enforcement.strict_quota=true for a subset of tenants on staging first.
infra-bot: deploy accepted: feature flag rollout started for orgs [staging-c] by priya at 1952467905
Priya: will add dashboard widgets: reserved_utilization, crossnode_borrow, in_flight_by_tenant, queue_latency and a sample of affected requests.
Alex: can we add user-visible note in console when tenant is in 'burst-borrow' mode? helps SRE and customers.
Jess: +1. UX: show "Using shared burst — temporarily limited" with link to docs and current Retry-After.
Marc: I'll PR router change and unit tests. Diane, can you own dashboard? Priya can coordinate rollout.
Diane: yep. I'll add alert runbook: if crossnode_borrow > 0.5% => page oncall and open incident.Major
Alex: thanks everyone — will follow-up with the event ids.
